ITEM 1 | White cooked grains, loose and fluffy with separate, slightly glossy kernels, mounded on the left side of the plate in an irregular heap about 9 cm across and 2 cm tall, sitting beside the meat and broccoli | 150
ITEM 2 | Brown-grey seared meat slice with a browned, slightly caramelized exterior and pinkish-brown interior, matte with some juice, cut into a roughly oval piece about 6 cm by 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick, resting between the rice and the other meat | 90
ITEM 3 | Browned, seared strips of meat with dark char marks and crisp edges, layered in an overlapping pile about 7 cm by 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick, positioned at the upper right of the plate | 85
ITEM 4 | Bright green broccoli florets with compact tops and pale green stems, several florets roughly 2 to 3 cm across, scattered along the lower edge of the rice and meat, slightly glossy and firm | 110
